headline: President Lee Orders Full Review of ISA and Anti-Stock Price Manipulation Bill
summary: President Lee Jae-myung ordered a complete review of the ISA reform plan and the anti-stock price manipulation bill. Both proposals have faced strong opposition.
why: The Individual Savings Account (ISA) is a tax-advantaged investment account in Korea, and the anti-manipulation bill would govern stock market conduct. Changes to either affect retail investment flows and market rules.
